verdict.rationale: Airwallex's AgentOS toolkit (docs-13) explicitly enables AI agents to act autonomously on a production account—reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building reports—and webhooks (docs-9) plus batch transfers (docs-7/19) support event-driven, background-style automation. However, there's no explicit documentation of scheduling, persistent background job orchestration, or independent evidence of agents running unattended over time. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/orchestration for long-running background tasks, and third-party/hands-on validation that AgentOS-driven automations actually run autonomously without human-in-the-loop intervention.
